components.description: A forked metal rod attuned to the destination plane; attunement is part of the problem.

compendium.summary: Willing-group planar travel; requires a 250+ gp attuned fork.
warnings: The Compendium index is an operating reference, not replacement spell text. Confirm the active D&D Beyond entry before casting.
Component planning: Before planar travel becomes an objective.
Pre-cast gate: Obtain the correct tuned fork and agree on destination precision.
Failure state: No legal focus, hostile arrival area, or no route home.
Safe operating default: Research the plane, define the return plan, and keep the party physically coordinated.
